notes: Dev RBox revision. Flips a property adjacency really has (being next to is mutual) to its opposite, asymmetry; adjacent_to's symmetry follows from no other tag, so there is no route back to the old property. Direct: 'If one bone is adjacent to another bone, is the second bone never adjacent to the first?' (no before, yes after). The instances are true but minor joints (pisiform and triquetrum in the wrist, cuboid and calcaneus in the foot): the first asks whether the converse follows (yes, then no), the second whether the fact rules the converse out (no, then yes). The cross-lingual queries ask the first instance; the Chinese prompt uses the directed '位于...旁边' since 相邻 reads as mutual by itself. Unrelated near: whether 'is a sister species of' is asymmetric (no). hops counts the prompt fact as one bridge (hops 2). Known weakness: a model that knows a joint joins two bones both ways could answer from that kept fact.
